findings: .descriptions.xml is an IDE inspection catalog with 2085 inspection nodes, not a dependency manifest. .xml is a saved report with 59 problem entries. All XML nodes were traversed structurally; complete prose review of the 2 MB catalog is not claimed.

Lint baseline contains 64 recorded issues generated by lint/AGP 8.2.2. Its dependency suggestions reference older versions than the pinned current build source previously read, establishing that these diagnostics are historical rather than a fresh build result.

ObsoleteLintCustomCheck records skipped Compose lint rules due to invalid referenced analysis APIs, including coroutine/state/remember checks. This is evidence of a historical qualification gap, not proof the current toolchain still skips them.

Baseline includes internal navigation inset resource reflection, modifier parameter order, unused resources, conditional logging and monochrome icon issues. Current occurrence and rendered impact require fresh toolchain/runtime validation.
Parsing saved diagnostics does not run lint, prove absence of new defects or qualify Android packaging.
